product_metadata.title: Reusable Silicone Food Storage Bags Bundle, 15 Pack | Includes 35oz Medium Food Preservation Bags set of (4), Beeswax Wrap Set of (3), Silicone Stretch Lids Set of (6), Bag Holder & Cotton Storage Bag as Packaging
features: 🍝 More Than a Set of Premium Storage Bags - You're getting 4 Medium (1000 mL / 35 oz.) Airtight Stand Up Silicone Bags for Food Storage, 3 Beeswax Wraps for Food, 6 Stretchy Reusable Food Covers (reusable silicone lids), 1 Storage Bag Rack Holder, and 1 Reusable Cotton Storage Bag. All in 1 set of maximum eco reusable food storage convenience! Upgrade your “green” lifestyle with plastic-free reusable sandwich bags and pure beewax wrappers

🍱 No Better Way To Keep Your Food Fresh – Single-use plastic food storage bags are an incredible waste of money, plus, they're not good for the planet; With the top silicone products in this set you'll be able to seal and wrap various foods as well as cover plates, cups & bowls, so everything stays protected and fresher, longer; all while reducing your carbon footprint. Say “Hello” to your go-to zero waste storage containers and the most flexible 6-piece must-have food cover set on the market

🐝 100% Made from Advanced Food-Grade Materials - Looking for planet-friendly snack bags for kids? The durable reusable baggies and cup/can stretch lids are made from premium food-grade silicone without toxins, BPA, tastes, or odors; Replace aluminum foil using the healthy, reusable food wraps made from natural beeswax, tree resin, cotton, and plant oils; All our silicone stretch lids and food covers plus the reusable ziplock bags are dishwasher safe, sustainable, and good for the environment

🌮 Multi-functional, Three-Dimensional, Leak-free Design – Whether you’re packing snacks/lunch for school, picnic, work, or prepping baby food, enjoy the best food-hugging solution to leak-free preservation. Our 3D standing ziplock bags are a breeze to fill – when pouring liquids, use the sturdy stand to keep resealable pouches open. To lock in more food-saving freshness, the silicon stretchable lids are extremely expandable – they fit like a glove over salad bowls, glassware, food cans and jars

🌡️ Able to Withstand Extreme Temperatures - And if you’re searching for the greatest microwavable silicone containers, you’re in luck! These re-zip reusable bags bravely survive temperatures ranging from -104 to 446 degrees Fahrenheit. Feel free to use them in the oven, microwave, freezer, and sous vide without concern; the slider at the top is very easy to close and forms an airtight, leak proof seal, so nothing gets in or out of your durable reusable silicone bags until you say so. Excellent!
